meta.source_event: v51 developer briefs - CVE, SSS, Quantum, BLFLAW

findings.title: curl mTLS Certificate Confusion
findings.description: curl mutual TLS certificate confusion can cause a connection expected to use one client certificate to authenticate with another certificate, undermining MAS TRM inter-system authentication controls.
findings.recommended_action: Upgrade curl to patched version and review mTLS certificate selection controls.

findings.title: Lantronix EDS5000 Unauthenticated Root Command Injection
findings.description: Unauthenticated command injection against serial-to-IP Lantronix EDS5000 devices creates OT/ICS lateral movement risk across serial-connected equipment.
findings.recommended_action: Upgrade Lantronix firmware and isolate serial-to-IP bridge devices from production networks.
findings.mas_trm_mapping: MAS TRM Section 9 - Network and third-party technology risk

findings.title: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Critical Chain - 34908
findings.description: Critical UniFi OS chain component from the same v51 KEV batch. Treat as internet-facing network management exposure.
findings.recommended_action: Patch UniFi OS immediately and restrict management plane access.

findings.title: Harvest Now Decrypt Later - Post-Quantum Cryptographic Exposure
findings.description: Long-lived encrypted financial and regulatory data captured today may become decryptable after cryptographically relevant quantum capability. No CVE applies; this is a cryptographic posture exposure.
findings.recommended_action: Inventory RSA/ECC dependent data flows and plan migration to NIST PQC algorithms.
findings.mas_trm_mapping: MAS TRM Section 9 - Long-term data protection

findings.title: Business Logic Flaw - IDOR / Broken Access Control
findings.description: Design-level authorization flaw where a valid authenticated request can access another user's object or workflow state. No CVE applies; DAST often records a valid 200 response and misses ownership semantics.
findings.recommended_action: Enforce object-level authorization checks and add regression tests for cross-user access.
findings.mas_trm_mapping: MAS TRM Section 9 - Application security controls

findings.title: Open Offensive AI Exploit Generation Tooling
findings.description: Open exploit-generation models and agentic exploit frameworks compress CVE-to-weaponization time for RCE, SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, JWT, and broken access control findings.
findings.recommended_action: Treat public PoC availability and low attacker skill threshold as TES escalation inputs; keep internal modifiers server-side.
